sources.title: Strongwiz v3 campaign prototype
sources.source_registry_scope_residual: The Strongwiz semantic registry reference identifies its own 14-entry source registry. It includes PAL v2.3 and an older Single Cut source, but not this intake's BRRRT v2.0, Single Cut v0.2 record, or Compactification Costs v0.2. Those works are not backdated into Strongwiz v3 development provenance.
sources.version_identity_residual: Package metadata at the inspected head declares 0.4.0.dev0 and pre-alpha status, while CITATION.cff still declares 0.2.0 and NOTICE.md still describes v0.2. This registry uses the package version and preserves the conflict rather than treating 0.4 as a tagged release.
sources.distribution_scope_residual: The reproducible wheel and source distribution contain the general Strongwiz kernel, not the repository-local calibration_003 harness. Installing the built package alone does not install or reproduce Calibration 003.
sources.upstream_portability_residual: Strongwiz's semantic source-registry reference is stable, but one receipt's raw registry-file SHA-256 is LF-Git-blob-specific while ordinary Windows checkout conversion changes the raw bytes. Current CI validates the semantic registry. The local README's exact-lock full-test recipe also omits the optional calibration dependencies that CI installs explicitly.

verification_evidence.claim_ceiling: Commit-bound development verification only; not Calibration 003 execution, ARC evidence, or Scribe-effect evidence. Frozen implementation-receipt counts and current-head CI counts are separate apertures.
